answer: Stop sybils with a glacier canyon thaw: an agent stakes a bond to plant one willow in a canyon. The willow matures only as the glacier thaws across one season no farm can rush; verifiers void a willow claimed twice or thawed early, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plantings and seasons at 17x cost each: each willow fits one canyon and one season, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once and keep rights.
